As an Operational Purchasing Coordinator you ensure that the right materials are available at the right time. The suppliers have already been selected and the commercial agreements have been established; from that point onwards, you take operational responsibility for the purchasing process. You are the link between suppliers, planning, production and logistics. You monitor purchase orders and delivery times, actively manage suppliers and take action whenever risks arise that could impact production. In a dynamic high-tech manufacturing environment, priorities can change quickly. It is therefore important that you maintain an overview, anticipate potential issues and take ownership until a problem has been fully resolved. What will you do? Place, manage and monitor purchase orders for raw materials and components. Monitor delivery times and coordinate deliveries with production and factory planning. Act as the first operational point of contact for suppliers and hold them accountable for agreements and performance. Make operational purchasing decisions based on lead times, costs and the total cost of a product or delivery. Wij bieden A gross hourly wage starting from €15.52, depending on your experience* Salary paid every 4 weeks (13 payments per year) Travel allowance from 20 kilometers per day (€0.14 per kilometer) 8% holiday allowance, paid in May 10% holiday hour accrual 5% year-end bonus 26 vacation days based on a full-time contract An extra day off on your birthday Fixed-term contracts with the prospect of continued employment Free parking at the hotel Opportunity to obtain your SVS Cleaning Certificate Various training and career development opportunities, including progression to Supervisor A friendly, supportive, and motivated team *Gross hourly wage applicable from age 20 and above. Jouw baan Together with your colleagues, you will ensure that hotel rooms and public areas are clean, fresh, and well-presented every day. Thanks to your efforts, guests enjoy a great first impression and a comfortable stay. Your responsibilities Cleaning hotel rooms and bathrooms Making beds and changing bed linen Vacuuming, mopping, and dusting surfaces Replenishing soap, shampoo, and guest amenities Keeping hallways and public areas clean and tidy The best part of the job? You can immediately see the results of your work and make a direct contribution to guest satisfaction every day. Working hours Working hours between 09:00 AM and 05:00 PM Flexible working days from Monday to Sunday, by mutual agreement Both part-time and full-time opportunities available This role is ideal if you are looking for an active daytime job with a healthy work-life balance. EW Facility Services For more than 30 years, EW Facility Services has been providing cleaning and maintenance services for hotels, offices, healthcare facilities, and other locations throughout the Netherlands. With over 3,000 colleagues nationwide, we are committed to delivering quality, hospitality, and excellent service every day. Together, we create clean, safe, and welcoming environments for guests, visitors, and employees. Jij bent

Available to work flexibly from Monday to Sunday Able to work independently and take responsibility Fluent in Dutch and/or English Detail-oriented with a strong sense of cleanliness Living in or near Noordwijkerhout, or able to travel easily to the hotel Previous cleaning experience is a plus, but not required. We will gladly teach you everything you need to know! Solliciteren Can you picture yourself working with the friendly team at NH Hotel Leeuwenhorst in Noordwijkerhout? Don't wait any longer and apply today. We look forward to welcoming you as our new Housekeeping Attendant!

jobs.occupation: Front Desk Agent (part-time) - Amsterdam Lake Hotel
jobs.description:
You are the hotel's calling card! With your service and hospitality, you have a huge impact on the guests' experience and satisfaction. That big smile on their face is your goal, because that makes you a big smile too!
What do we do? The work of our department is very diverse, everyday is different. Within your role as a Front Desk Agent, your responsibilities include the safety and experience of our hotel guests. The work includes: 
• Welcoming, checking in and checking out our hotel guests
• Optimising the guest experience and ensuring they have an unforgettable time
• Dealing with and resolving hotel guests' challenges and inconveniences
• Various administrative duties 
• F&B work
• Keeping guests informed of fun events in the area

• You have experience with a hotel reservation system, preferably MEWS

• You have a hospitable attitude 
• You are flexible and enjoy working different shifts, including weekends and holidays 
• You are independent 
What can you expect from us?
• A competitive salary
